subject.name: Photonics Technicians
subject.summary: Photonics technicians (O*NET 17-3029.08) assemble, install, test, or maintain optical equipment such as lasers, lenses, mirrors, and fiber optics and record test data. Working with work orders, device batches, calibration status, test conditions, and safety authorization, they produce reviewable assembly and test records, anomaly isolation, and equipment maintenance handovers. Laser, electrical, cleanroom, and precision equipment operations must follow institutional training and authorization. Work settings, qualifications, and final responsibility must be checked against local and institutional rules.
